rules: $operating_margin and $asset_turnover caused both coverage failures (0.853, 0.893) plus three cheap-screen misses at |t| 0.13-0.52; retire both fields. The fundamentals that carried every accepted leg were $roe, $roa, $accrual_gap and TS_DELTA($leverage, 63).

Combine a fundamental leg and a price/volume leg by subtracting two cross-sectional ranks; every fitness above 3.0 had that shape, while products of two CS_ZSCORE legs were the single largest cheap-screen failure group (5 of 8).
Stop using TS_SUM($return, n) over 21-105 days as a standalone leg: three such proposals screened at |t| 0.37-0.50, and the one accepted 5-day version scored 0.030.

In price_volume niches, short/long moving-average ratios of $close, $high, $low topped out near fitness 1.0; the only strong one (2.835) used TS_ARGMIN/TS_ARGMAX position over a 189-day window. Prefer long-window timing/position operators over MA ratios there.
Shift proposal budget toward mixed niches: they returned 3.14-5.04 this round versus 0.03-2.84 for pure price_volume, across all three speeds.

Swapping only the outer wrapper (CS_RANK to CS_DEMEAN or CS_ZSCORE) or replacing one leaf with its TS_MEAN over a new window is not novelty; all five archive_subtree rejections were exactly that, sharing 5-12 nodes. Change the operator skeleton or the data fields instead.

Three mutations landed 4-8 edits away because a fresh short expression was attached to an unrelated parent. Either pick a parent that already shares the skeleton and change one window or one field, or submit the idea as a new seed rather than a mutation.
Track proposals already made this run before submitting bare single-fundamental ranks: both duplicates were canonical one-liners over $roa and $roe.
